capabilities: Answer FAQ questions from stored FAQ notes
Map folders, note types and links on a circular bundle map
Inspect a note's authorship, review state, links and format problems
List questions assistants asked that no note answers
Show git sync state and notes waiting to be checked
disambiguation: Not a password vault or backup tool; it builds a shared knowledge base and review view over existing Markdown notes.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); the companion program is downloaded separately and must be kept on the same version as the plugin; the bundle map works without it, other views do not; full guide in docs/server.md.
problem: Notes written for people give assistants no stored answers or review state, and there is no single view of which notes are broken, stale or unchecked.

relations.evidence: Assistants such as Claude Code look things up in the same notes
It can also link notes to Jira tickets
A team usually keeps the vault in a shared git repository, for example on GitHub.

requires.name: Claude Code or another MCP assistant

summary: Knowledge-base layer that answers FAQ questions from notes, maps note types and links, and flags notes that need review.
